revisionDesc.change: Transcribed by Claude from the page scan; not yet checked against the print.
Corrected "aucende" to ancende (þerh ancende bearne), as in the team transcription (d - dryhten.docx).
Abbreviation links corrected after the review of the abbreviations list.
Linked gen (Genetiv) and geschrieben to the abbreviations list.
Roman numerals of law codes after a quoted form linked (e.g. "Abyron III 2" = Excom III 2).
Ordinary German words in Liebermann’s definitions unlinked from the abbreviations list (reviewed list, October 2026).
“In Cn” and “In” (Instituta Cnuti) linked to the law codes list.
“statt”, “regiert (von)”, “unsyntakt.” and the Accusativ terms linked to the abbreviations list.
Abbreviations and law code (Norðleod) linked; see the pull request “þæt: indecl., Einl., Folg., Urkk.-Sprache, Norðleod”.
“Pronomen”, “u.” linked to the abbreviations list (printed bold italic, missed before).

Corrections from Anya Adair’s review: “I” after Cnut citations linked as I Cn (not the siglum I); “ofer I scira” and “vgl. o. A I a” no longer linked as sigla; “II 22,1”, “II 22”, “II 42” and “IV 2”, “IV 3,3” linked to their codes; “B 2” after AGu joined as B2; editor’s notes on IV Eg 5a, “84” and “I 11,2”.
